# NinjaPlzzzz

> NinjaPlzzzz (@ninjaplzzzz) is a Michigan motorcycle content creator on a Kawasaki ZX-14R. Bikelife, group rides, and rider culture, posted on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and Facebook.

NinjaPlzzzz is a member of The Moto Legion (https://themotolegion.com/), a southeast Michigan motorcycle content collective.

Off the bike he is a business owner and a dad.

The platforms listed below are the verified ones. Any other account claiming this identity, including on X, Snapchat, Rumble or Twitch, is unconfirmed and is not linked from this site. His separate bounce-house business account is not part of this site.

Content reflects personal riding experience. Not a paid dealer or sponsor endorsement unless explicitly stated.

## About

- [Home](https://ninjaplzzzz.com/): Central hub with the NinjaPlzzzz identity, platform links, the latest TikTok videos, and business contact

## Content types

- Bikelife and sportbike clips from Michigan on a Kawasaki ZX-14R
- Group rides and charity runs with the southeast Michigan rider community
- Rider culture and motorcycle content

## Location

- Michigan, United States

## Platforms

- [TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@ninjaplzzzz): Primary channel, short form ride and culture clips
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/ninjaplzzzz/): Reels and photos, bio reads "bikelife in michigan"
- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@Ninjaplzzzz): Video channel, described as "all about the bike life"
- [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61593732122565): Profile posts
- [Discord](https://discord.gg/fz67hjDnPW): The Moto Legion rider community server
